Questions

Is Falia really free to start?
Yes. The daily practice, Today's moment, six playlists and a narrator voice in your language are free, with no time limit.
What does Premium add?
The full library of playlists, a choice of five voices in every language, recording affirmations in your own voice, calm soundscapes and a sleep timer.
Which languages does Falia speak?
English, Turkish, Spanish and Portuguese, with Dawn and Night themes you can switch any time.
Is my voice private?
Yes. Your recordings and your voice are yours. Recording your own voice is optional, for adults 18 and over, and you can delete your voice, or your whole account, whenever you choose.
Does Falia show ads?
No, never, on any plan.
